dataset: Step 2e optimal threshold pair (OSR11, current method)
why_archived: outputs/threshold_calibration/ is excluded by .gitignore, so this table was not under version control. It is declared in src/03_storm_catalog_generation/config/analysis_config.py as the sole authorised threshold source for Step 3, which makes a stale copy able to silently produce a catalogue that disagrees with the published one. That is exactly what was found on 2026-08-04: the working copy still held the superseded q90/q90 pair while the published catalogue had been generated with q70/q99.
recovered_from: Institutional processing server (MASTER/IAG-USP), where the raw-data processing and the Step 2e recalibration of 2026-07-30 were run: outputs/threshold_calibration/tables/
verification: load_threshold_pair() in detection_hat.py compares the runtime table against this archive on every read and raises if they disagree.
